rationale: Stacks uses the presheaf gluing formulation and stalks in place of the equivalent espace-etale presentation; the same sheaf object and constant-sheaf example result.
The local-homeomorphism axiom is the espace-etale form of local representability by sections used in the Stacks stalk and sheafification construction.
Continuity of the fibrewise group laws is replaced by the equivalent requirement that the section presheaf be a sheaf of abelian groups.
Stacks defines the stalk as the filtered colimit of sections over open neighbourhoods and uses the same restriction maps.
Stacks sheafification reconstructs the sheaf from the local germs of a presheaf and supplies its universal property.
The FAC local-zero criterion is exactly separatedness and Stacks identifies it with injectivity into the sheafification.
Under separatedness the stated compatible-local-section criterion is exactly surjectivity onto the sheafification and hence the sheaf axiom.
A sheaf is canonically unchanged by sheafification; Stacks gives this through the universal property and equality on stalks.
Stacks develops restriction and gluing as an equivalence with descent data on an open covering.
The Stacks gluing lemmas have the same cocycle data existence uniqueness and compatibility and also cover module structures.
Stacks identifies closed pushforward by its stalks and characterizes its essential image categorically not only by global sections.
Full faithfulness of closed pushforward and the stalk characterization imply the stated bijection of global sections.
Closed pushforward gives the unique sheaf with the prescribed stalks on the closed subset and zero stalks off it.
Stacks treats sheaves of many algebraic structures uniformly and defines sheaves of modules over a sheaf of rings.
Stacks constructs kernels and cokernels including the sheafification required for quotients and proves that sheaves of modules form an abelian category.
Stacks defines module morphisms and develops kernels images cokernels and exactness categorically with stalkwise detection.
The abelian-category result proves the kernel image coimage and cokernel statements and the stalkwise exactness assertion in a stronger unified form.
Stacks identifies finite sums with products and extends the construction to arbitrary coproducts and all limits and colimits.
Stacks gives the universal construction of the tensor-product sheaf its stalk formula symmetry associativity and right exactness.
The tensor-product sheaf defined by sheafification has exactly the prescribed stalks and local pure-tensor sections giving the stated existence and uniqueness.

Stacks gives the same internal Hom sheaf canonical stalk map bifunctoriality left exactness and finite direct-sum identities and strengthens the later stalk comparison with finite-type and finite-presentation criteria.
